description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about when to hand a case to a person.

files.description: A Confluence page in the support-playbooks space for support agents about when to hand a case to a person, last updated between 2026-01-12 and 2026-05-15. It must contain these sentences word for word: "safety, legal and conduct cases go to a person"; "an injury or a medical issue: reason safety"; "a lawyer or legal action: reason legal"; "discrimination: reason conduct"; "not_covered is for a question no policy covers: do not guess"; "a policy that is announced but whose process is not published yet is not_covered"; "asking for a person is not enough". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention battery, batteries, lithium, power bank, watt-hour.
